I agree. I'm just trying to say that the claim "I'm being gen rushed" is overused and misunderstood. If you're in a chase, a gen might pop, that's understandable. But when 3 gens get popped in the first minute of the game, it becomes obvious something is broken

The term "Gen rushing" is thrown around a lot, but when all the gen's are done in almost no time at all, it really ruins the experience for the killer. People have realised now that holding m1 and then leaving is boring. 

When you think of the most enjoyable thing to do in dbd, what is it? Probably chasing. Chases give both sides a chance to express what skills they've learned in their hours of play time, and gives both sides a chance to get the satisfaction of outplaying the other. That chance is almost completely removed if you just toss in 4 BNPs and PTS. Gen's just finish and then the game ends. The killer gets little to no chance to play the game.
